about.heading: About Gila
about.passage: Art has been my language for as long as I can remember. From my early studies in Moscow to the vibrant art scene in Israel, I've always been drawn to the moment when someone picks up a brush for the first time — and discovers something about themselves they didn't know was there.
about.passage2: I bring years of experience in art education and art therapy. I've worked with children, teenagers, adults — people from all walks of life. Each person sees the world differently, and I love helping them express that unique vision through their hands.
about.passage3: My classes happen in the warmth of a home, not an institution. Here, there is no right or wrong — only discovery, colour, and the joy of creating something that is truly yours.
about.languages: I speak English, German, Russian & Hebrew
